default.title: Fractional staff contact integration
default.summary: Let authorized Fractional administrators find staff contacts from their organization in CRM.
features: Fractional can search existing organization contacts when preparing a staff invitation.
After a staff member accepts their invitation, Fractional can link their verified email to an existing contact or create a contact under the organization.
fixes: An existing contact stays with its current company when an email matches outside the organization contact list.
